turns.responseText:
BCR-ABL1 CRO Submission Export — WuXi AppTec — Validates cardiac safety, computes physicochemical properties, and formats all 5 ranked BCR-ABL1 compounds into a WuXi AppTec-ready submission package.

Input: 5 compounds (Asciminib #1, Bosutinib #2, Imatinib #3, Gleevec-analog-2 #4, Gleevec-analog-1 #5) with SMILES, IC50 (nM), hERG IC50 (μM), and composite scores from BCR-ABL1 campaign ranking
Key steps:

hERG safety gate → flags any compound with hERG IC50 ≤ 1 μM as cardiac-unsafe and excludes from export
RDKit MW/LogP calculation → computes molecular weight and lipophilicity from SMILES for each passing compound
WuXi AppTec column formatter → maps compound_id, SMILES, IC50 (nM), hERG IC50 (μM), MW, LogP, and composite score to WuXi submission schema → exports wuxiapptec_submission.csv


Expected output: wuxiapptec_submission.csv (WuXi-formatted compound table with all 5 entries, provided all pass the hERG IC50 > 1 μM cardiac safety threshold) + submission_metadata.json (run summary, safety gate results, and excluded compound log)

Required inputs

Input data files (e.g., structures/SMILES, assay data, or concentration-time table)
Basic study metadata (condition, units, and endpoint definitions)

Next step
